Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.kn: ಏಯ್! ನೀನು ನಮ್ಮ ಊಟಕ್ಕೆ ಅಡ್ಡಿಪಡಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದೀಯ! ಎಷ್ಟು ಅಸಭ್ಯ!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.te: ఏయ్! నువ్వు మా భోజనానికి అడ్డుపడుతున్నావ్! ఎంత మర్యాద లేనితనం!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.ta: ஏய்! நீ எங்கள் இரவு உணவை இடையூறு செய்கிறாய்! என்ன அநாகரிகம்!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.th: เฮ้! แกมาขัดจังหวะมื้อเย็นของเรา! ไม่มีมารยาทเลย!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.vi: Này! Anh đang làm gián đoạn bữa tối của chúng tôi đấy! Thật vô lễ!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.id: Hei! Kamu mengganggu makan malam kami! Tidak sopan sekali!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.ms: Hei! Kamu mengganggu makan malam kami! Biadab betul!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.sw: Hebu! Unaikatiza chakula chetu cha jioni! Huna adabu kabisa!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.zh-Hans: 喂！你打扰我们吃晚饭了！太没礼貌了！
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.zh-Hant: 喂！你打擾我們吃晚飯了！太沒禮貌了！
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.yue-Hant-HK: 喂！你阻住我哋食緊晚飯呀！咁冇禮貌嘅！
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.ko-polite: 이봐요! 우리 저녁 식사를 방해하고 있잖아요! 정말 무례하네요!
Hey! You're interrupting our dinner! How.ja: おい！僕たちの夕食の邪魔をしているぞ！なんて失礼な！

We're trying to eat here!.th: เรากำลังพยายามกินข้าวอยู่นะ!
We're trying to eat here!.vi: Chúng tôi đang cố ăn ở đây mà!
We're trying to eat here!.id: Kami sedang berusaha makan di sini!
We're trying to eat here!.ms: Kami sedang cuba makan di sini!
We're trying to eat here!.zh-Hans: 我们正想在这儿吃饭呢！
We're trying to eat here!.zh-Hant: 我們正想在這兒吃飯呢！
We're trying to eat here!.ko-polite: 우리 여기서 밥 좀 먹으려고 하잖아요!
We're trying to eat here!.ja: ここで食事をしようとしているんだ！

Mmm, this soup is delicious!.te: ఊఁ, ఈ సూప్ చాలా రుచిగా ఉంది!
Mmm, this soup is delicious!.ta: ம்ம், இந்த சூப் மிகவும் சுவையாக இருக்கு!
Mmm, this soup is delicious!.th: อืม ซุปนี้อร่อยจัง!
Mmm, this soup is delicious!.vi: Mmm, món súp này ngon quá!
Mmm, this soup is delicious!.sw: Mmm, supu hii ni tamu sana!
Mmm, this soup is delicious!.ja: うーん、このスープおいしい！

Could you pass the salt?.th: ช่วยส่งเกลือให้หน่อยได้ไหม?
Could you pass the salt?.vi: Bạn chuyền giúp lọ muối được không?
Could you pass the salt?.yue-Hant-HK: 可唔可以唥啲鹽畀我呀？
Could you pass the salt?.ja: 塩を取ってもらえますか？

Who wants more rice?.th: ใครอยากได้ข้าวเพิ่มบ้าง?
Who wants more rice?.ja: ご飯のおかわりはだれ？

Careful — the plates are hot!.th: ระวังนะ — จานร้อนอยู่!
Careful — the plates are hot!.vi: Cẩn thận — mấy cái đĩa nóng đấy!
Careful — the plates are hot!.ja: 気をつけて——お皿が熱いよ！

There's a giant at our window!.kn: ನಮ್ಮ ಕಿಟಕಿಯ ಬಳಿ ಒಬ್ಬ ದೈತ್ಯ ಇದ್ದಾನೆ!
There's a giant at our window!.te: మన కిటికీ దగ్గర ఒక రాక్షసుడు ఉన్నాడు!
There's a giant at our window!.th: มียักษ์อยู่ที่หน้าต่างบ้านเรา!
There's a giant at our window!.vi: Có một người khổng lồ ở cửa sổ nhà mình!
There's a giant at our window!.zh-Hans: 我们窗户那儿有个巨人！
There's a giant at our window!.zh-Hant: 我們窗戶那兒有個巨人！
There's a giant at our window!.yue-Hant-HK: 我哋個窗度有個巨人呀！
There's a giant at our window!.ja: うちの窓に巨人がいるよ！

Dinner's getting cold!.th: อาหารเย็นกำลังจะเย็นแล้วนะ!
